modules.name: 时钟日历
modules.author: sansheng
modules.description: 时钟 + 当月日历,今天高亮;零网络零密钥,最稳的地基。
modules.description_en: Clock plus a current-month calendar with today highlighted; no network, no keys — the rock-solid foundation tile.

modules.name: 天气
modules.author: sansheng
modules.description: 当前天气 + 7 天预报(温度曲线);open-meteo 免密可用,可选彩云 token。
modules.description_en: Current conditions plus a 7-day forecast with temperature curves; works keyless via open-meteo, optional Caiyun token.

modules.name: 待办清单
modules.author: sansheng
modules.description: 在壁纸上就地勾选 / 新增 / 编辑 / 删除待办;交互旗舰,零网络零密钥。
modules.description_en: Check off / add / edit / delete todos right on the wallpaper; the interactive flagship, no network, no keys.

modules.name: GitHub 动态
modules.author: sansheng
modules.description: 你的 star / PR 概览 + 热门仓列表;有 gh CLI 走 CLI,否则降级匿名 REST。
modules.description_en: Your stars / PR overview plus top-repo list; uses gh CLI when present, else falls back to anonymous REST.

modules.name: 网络延迟
modules.author: sansheng
modules.description: 多目标网络延迟(ping / TLS 握手),一眼看网快不快。
modules.description_en: Latency to several targets (ping / TLS handshake) — see at a glance how fast your network is.

modules.name: 服务状态
modules.author: sansheng
modules.description: 服务健康(HTTP 状态码 + 延迟 / ping),盯自己的站点在不在。
modules.description_en: Service health (HTTP status code + latency / ping) — watch whether your own sites are up.
